briefings.title: CMU Miami | Interview with Ken Griffin
briefings.tldr: Ken Griffin announced a historic $3 billion philanthropic commitment to Carnegie Mellon University—the largest individual gift in higher education history—funding a $1 billion investment in Pittsburgh (including naming the Kenneth C. Griffin School of Computer Science) and a $2 billion expansion to establish CMU Miami.

briefings.title: Citadel CEO Ken Griffin & Carnegie Mellon President Farnam Jahanian Talk Donation, New Campus |...
briefings.tldr: Citadel CEO Ken Griffin is committing a record $3 billion to Carnegie Mellon University—with $2 billion funding a new campus in Miami and $1 billion supporting the main Pittsburgh campus, including naming the Kenneth C. Griffin School of Computer Science—to pioneer a tech-forward, interdisciplinary model for higher education focused on return on investment and grand societal challenges.

briefings.title: Griffin Gives $3 Billion to Carnegie Mellon for Miami Campus
briefings.tldr: Citadel founder Ken Griffin is donating a record-breaking $3 billion to Carnegie Mellon University—doubling his total lifetime contributions to roughly $5.7 billion—with a significant portion funding a new CMU campus in Miami designed around a pioneering, interdisciplinary model for higher education.

briefings.title: Watch CNBC's interview with Citadel's Ken Griffin and Carnegie Mellon Univ. Pres. Farnam Jahanian
briefings.tldr: Citadel CEO Ken Griffin announced a historic $3 billion investment in Carnegie Mellon University (CMU) alongside President Farnam Jahanian, aimed at reshaping higher education and establishing a new integrated campus model in Miami focused on societal grand challenges.

briefings.title: $6 Gas CHAOS, Ken Griffin RIPS Mamdani + Nvidia’s AI Home TAKEOVER | PBD #792
briefings.tldr: This briefing highlights key corporate strategy and economic shifts discussed on the PBD Podcast, analyzing Starbucks' premium pricing model under Brian Niccol, MicroStrategy's mounting debt pressure, Nvidia's residential AI power grid play, and California's escalating energy and public health crises.

briefings.title: MAGA Dominates the Indiana Primaries; Ken Griffin "Doubles Down" on NYC Exodus, & More | RCPod
briefings.tldr: MAGA-backed challengers dominated the Indiana GOP primaries, signaling Donald Trump’s continued intra-party influence, while billionaire Ken Griffin’s pivot to Miami highlights a growing "capital flight" from progressive-led cities facing safety and tax concerns.

briefings.title: A Conversation with Citadel’s Ken Griffin | Global Conference 2026
briefings.tldr: Ken Griffin views the U.S. economy as uniquely resilient due to energy independence and a technology-driven productivity boom, though he warns that persistent inflation and declining urban safety standards necessitate a strategic shift toward business-friendly hubs like Miami.

briefings.title: Stanford Leadership Forum 2026: Conversation with Ken Griffin
briefings.tldr: Leadership in a volatile, AI-driven era requires a relentless commitment to meritocracy, the agility to abandon "sunk costs" immediately, and a focus on lifelong learning to stay ahead of rapid technological shifts that are eroding traditional competitive moats.

briefings.title: Ken Griffin - Founder and CEO of Citadel | Investment Conference 2026
briefings.tldr: Citadel’s success is built on an unapologetic "winning" culture that prioritizes rapid, decentralized decision-making and a disciplined approach to technology where high-impact execution is favored over experimental breadth.

briefings.title: Watch: Citadel CEO Ken Griffin at WSJ Invest Live | WSJ
briefings.tldr: Citadel CEO Ken Griffin outlined his concerns over US fiscal policy, government overreach in business, and eroding public ethics, while defending the dollar's long-term strength and explaining Citadel's strategic shift to Florida due to quality of life issues.
